guards.situation: From Domů the customer can only reach the booking form through the bike detail, where REZERVOVAT stays disabled until a date is chosen and a red ValidationBanner warns about licence, overlap with own bookings and min/max rental days.
guards.customer_sees: Grey disabled REZERVOVAT with "first select dates" hint; red banner with the licence / overlap / length problem before the form.
guards.server: yes(trg_check_booking_overlap, trg_check_user_booking_overlap, trg_check_booking_branch_open); licence on a NEW booking: unknown (license_insufficient found only in swap/modify RPCs, e.g. supabase/migrations/20260912_moto_swap_no_storno.sql:141); min/max rental days: unknown
v2_where: lib/features/home/v2/home_funnel_v2.dart:209-217 (funnel REZERVOVAT -> startBookingFromSelection) -> lib/features/booking/booking_entry.dart:27-91 (pushes /booking directly); funnel shown when no paid active booking: lib/features/home/v2/home_screen_v2.dart:98, :116
guards.verdict_evidence: The v2 Home funnel is a NEW entry that reaches /booking without the bike detail, so the detail's ValidationBanner (overlap with the customer's own bookings, min/max rental days, licence) is not shown before the form. Mitigations verified: dates are always set (funnel_provider.dart:47 nearest weekend, :64-69 past ranges dropped), each bike is pre-checked with the same motoAvailableForRange as the catalogue date filter (funnel_provider.dart:149-165), licence-ineligible bikes, trailers, closed branches and kids' bikes (unless rented before) are filtered out (funnel_provider.dart:108-126), REZERVOVAT is disabled while loading (home_funnel_v2.dart:196-197). The booking form still computes bookingValidationErrorProvider (booking_provider.dart:298-302, used in core/booking_form_widget.dart:415; v2 maps it in features/booking/v2/booking_sync_v2.dart:77-80) - its blocking in the v2 form is another bucket and was not re-traced here. A customer whose own booking overlaps the weekend, or whose bike has min_rental_days > 3, is told only inside the form, not before. The other v2 entries hold: the funnel card tap opens the detail (home_funnel_v2.dart:183-189), and the calculator shows ValidationBanner (calc_step_dates_v2.dart:108) and disables REZERVOVAT when busy / loading / failed (calc_body_v2.dart:112-161).
